caption: Tapping row 1 runs prepare, which sets detail.fare to ₹158, and the push takes the stack from one screen to two. Back pops Detail and returns to the same fare list.

spec.aria: A four-step flow for the fare list example: tapping row 1, prepare setting detail.fare to 158, pushing Detail so the stack grows from 1 to 2 controllers, and Back popping Detail while the list stays unchanged.
